### What Did Job Mean When He Said "My Redeemer Lives"?
Author: Betty Dunn
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-job-mean-my-redeemer-lives.html
Passage: Job 19:25
Points:
- Job's renowned confession of hope arose not from comfort, but in the depths of grief and harsh criticism from his companions.
- Even before God restored his health and fortunes, Job held on to faith that his living Redeemer would ultimately prevail.
- Job looked past the destruction of his mortal body to the assurance of beholding God with his own eyes.
- Encountering the sovereign majesty of God reframes our painful earthly circumstances and deepens our faith.
- Believers facing heartbreak can find peace knowing our Redeemer lives, cares for us, and holds our future.

### Bible Pathway - June 19, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-june-19-2012.html
Passage: Job 19:25
Points:
- Unjust accusations and bitter trials did not destroy Job; they drove him closer to the Lord.
- Rather than condemning or judging suffering friends as Job's companions did, believers are called to bear one another's burdens with grace.
- Job endured intense affliction and isolation because his hope rested on the glorious future appearance of his Redeemer.
- This Old Testament declaration foreshadows Jesus Christ, the living Redeemer who delivers believers from sin and death into eternal life.
